stories.text: Tom leaves a blue ribbon on Rosa’s doorstep every evening
Nia meets a secret sweetheart by the garden gate after dusk
Arun opened a sealed letter and pretended the rain had loosened it
Wren rang the chapel bell at midnight and blamed the wind
Oren took the boathouse key so nobody could inspect his unfinished boat
Cora claimed that an old traveller’s story was her own adventure
Jonah slipped away from his shift to have a secret supper with Greta
Silas promised to check the bridge before dusk and never arrived
